# Richmond Scientific

> Richmond Scientific supplies precision laboratory equipment including balances, centrifuges, environmental chambers, and storage solutions from leading manufacturers like Ohaus, A&D, POL-EKO, and Arctiko.

Richmond Scientific is a distributor of high-quality scientific instruments and laboratory equipment serving research, pharmaceutical, and industrial testing applications. The company specializes in precision weighing devices, sample preparation equipment, and environmental control systems from trusted global manufacturers.

## Key Topics

- Precision balances

## Precision Balances & Weighing

- [Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new): New scientific balances from Ohaus and A&D with precision weighing
- [3dp Precision Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new/3dp-precision): 3 decimal place precision balances from Ohaus and A&D
- [4dp Analytical Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new/4dp-analytical): 4 decimal place analytical balances for precise 0.1mg weighing
- [5dp Semi-Micro Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new/5dp-semi-micro): 5 decimal place semi-micro balances for pharmaceutical research
- [6dp Micro Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new/6dp-micro): 6 decimal place microbalances for ultra-precision trace analysis
- [Moisture Balances](https://www.richmondscientific.com/product-category/new/balances-new/moisture-balances-new): Ohaus and A&D moisture analysers for quality control testing
